newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn firms, soy and wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn firms, soy and wheat steady.

text.p: CHICAGO, Sept 13 - FOB Gulf basis values for corn firmed in the nearby positions on Friday while soybean and wheat values were mostly steady.
"Farmers are reluctant to sell their corn," one dealer said, referring to higher CIF values.

In export news, the Egyptian state's main grain buyer said on Friday he wanted bids for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. soft red or soft white wheat by 0930 local/0630 GMT on Saturday. The wheat is for loading between October 15 and 31.
Dealers quoted the following afternoon FOB U.S. Gulf values, basis Chicago futures, except hard red winter wheat basis Kansas City. (In cents per bushel).
